preserved_authority_law: Version/Rollback does not become a second Lifecycle Transition authority.
No prior PASS transfers to Author Decision Queue bytes.
Author decisions are explicit human/author authority records; no provider, evaluator, runtime or qualification may synthesize a choice or approval.
Prose and Book Evaluator remain child/lane evidence sources and cannot resolve parent author decisions.
Publication authorization remains separate even when an author decision is required for release.

current_parent_critical_path.objective: Forensically map all existing AUTHOR_DECISION objects, Runtime V2 author_handoff semantics, Lifecycle AUTHOR_DECISION_REQUIRED gates, Version/Rollback authority-ingest behavior, export/publication author boundaries and current UI/product expectations; then perform bounded external research on human approval/decision workflow safety, provenance, stale-decision invalidation, concurrency and accessibility before defining any new executable Author Decision Queue runtime.
must_answer: What exact queue/request/decision semantics already exist and must be reused?
Which decisions are author-only versus parent-operational versus external/legal authority?
How is an unresolved decision bound to an exact subject/version/digest and invalidated when that subject changes?
How are options, evidence, disagreements, consequences and safe defaults presented without steering or fabricating consent?
How are duplicate handoffs, replay, concurrent resolution, defer/reopen, supersession and withdrawal handled?
How does a recorded author choice become an immutable AUTHOR_DECISION without directly mutating canonical state?
How do lifecycle, integration runtime, version/rollback and export freeze consume the decision without transferring author authority?
What minimum accessibility and mobile interaction requirements apply to the future System Master decision UI without moving UI ownership into Book runtime?
current_parent_critical_path.pass_proves: The Author Decision Queue implementation boundary is research-verified, reuse-first, authority-safe and sufficiently specified to begin a versioned executable contract without duplicating existing Runtime/Lifecycle/Versioning responsibilities.
current_parent_critical_path.on_failure: Preserve the forensic/research checkpoint, classify the exact unresolved authority/workflow/standards question, and do not implement queue runtime until the research gate is satisfied.

generic_continue_rule: In Book System control, Continue executes BOOK-SYSTEM-AUTHOR-DECISION-QUEUE-001-FORENSIC-AND-RESEARCH-001. Do not begin executable Author Decision Queue implementation until that research gate closes.
second_shift_requirement: Retire the Version/Rollback A-01 handoff as completed, preserve its exact evidence, and delegate only bounded Author Decision Queue forensic/research work if the live Book head remains exact.
qualification_effect: Version/Rollback is authoritative PASS only on exact subject 402ab84a14e9d345530d60394ebc36176541dd21. State-015 creates no Author Decision Queue implementation, human choice, manuscript promotion, export freeze, publication or production authority.
